answer: Random beacon spot-checks with heartbeats stop sybil farming. Each identity must answer random VRF calls; one that wanders off and misses a call is demoted. Each identity docks at a public wharf, its heartbeat log open to all. Running 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live machines: at 0.5 POA a heartbeat a day, that is 500 POA daily; one honest identity pays 0.5 POA. Idle fakes pile into a mesa of cost; honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted.
